environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate. ALB has an associated AWS WAF WebACL with a custom rate-based rule (RateBasedStatement) scoped to URI path matching '/api/v1/auth/reset-password' with an aggregate key of FORWARDED_IP (using X-Forwarded-For with fallback to source IP). The rate threshold is set to 5 requests per 5-minute evaluation window. Action is BLOCK with custom response code 429. Additionally, a second rate-based rule targets '/api/v1/auth/forgot-password' at 3 requests per 5-minute window per IP. The WAF rule priority places these rate-based rules at priority 1 and 2, before any allow rules. CloudFront distribution sits in front of the ALB with the same WebACL attached at the CloudFront level, ensuring rate evaluation occurs at edge before reaching the ALB. Note: the WAF rate-based rules use a 5-minute sliding window and AWS evaluates against aggregated request counts, meaning burst attempts within the window are counted cumulatively.

config.alb_access: ALB security group restricts inbound to CloudFront managed prefix list only
